name: A Midsummer Night's Dream
source:
This is a transformation of one of Shakespeare's most popular works to visual novel form, while keeping the play script and directions format intact.

[From [URL=http://renai.us/game/midsummer.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/URL]]
translation:

[来自[URL=http://renai.us/game/midsummer.shtml]仁爱档案[/URL]]
